notes: Kept all three old kinds (Thobe k123, Abaya k126, Wrap robe k125) with their old s and added planned Kaftan (sourced). Old flat models became archetypes: Dishdasha, Kandura, Jalabiya, Djellaba, Gandoura, Kachabia (Thobe); Manteau (Abaya); Deel, Chapan, Gho (Wrap robe). Added Saudi thobe, Bisht, Black abaya and Kaftan archetypes (Ottoman, Moroccan, Takchita, Algerian, Karakou, Chedda, Western). Left out: Toby thobe brand and Riyadh abaya designers (no retrievable page); Hessa Falasi (snippet only); blouza (no page); bekasab as separate archetype (only a fabric detail; tied to chapan in dt); burnous (a hooded cloak, not a robe; suggest Cape kind in Coats, source https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burnous retrieved); Senegalese kaftan/boubou left to African dress shelf; Uzbek ikat tradition may duplicate the Named cloths shelf's Ikat entry, merge there. Bisht placed under Abaya as the men's abaa; move to its own kind if the merger prefers.
